shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat AGENTS.md && echo '---' && ls -la node_modules/next/dist/docs | sed -n '1,200p' && echo '---' && rg -n \"refresh\\(|Server Action|server action|next/cache|revalidate|redirect\" node_modules/next/dist/docs -S | head -n 80 && echo '---' && sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && echo '---' && rg -n \""'^#|refresh'"\\(|from 'next/cache'|Server Action\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app -S | head -n 200 && echo '---' && rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app | rg \"refresh|server-actions|mutating-data|server-action|next/cache\""

/bin/bash -lc "find app -maxdepth 3 -type f -print | sort && echo '---' && sed -n '1,260p' app/page.tsx && echo '---' && rg -n \"cookies\\(|next/headers|use server|refresh\\(\" app node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app -S | head -n 120"
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && echo '---' && git diff -- app/actions.ts app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- package.json && echo '---' && ls -la .next >/dev/null 2>&1; echo \"has .next: "'$?" && echo '"'---' && git diff -- tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -lc 'git checkout -- package.json tsconfig.json && git clean -fd .next next-env.d.ts && git status --short'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' app/actions.ts && echo '---' && sed -n '1,260p' app/page.tsx && echo '---' && sed -n '1,220p' app/layout.tsx"
